The day value 17 makes the format unambiguous, and it matches batch 13's ingest date of 2026-01-18 (each batch covers the previous day), so parsing both formats gives correct data.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.9, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH p AS (SELECT *, COALESCE(try_strptime(txn_ts, '%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S'), TRY_CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP)) AS ts_parsed FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(ts_parsed AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(ts_parsed AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM p"}}
